tips.text: Refine the Rare relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each) in a radshare squad, but leave the Blueprint relics Intact since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Buy extra Tipedo Prime Handle relics; Handle is the Rare in every one of them and the slowest part to land.
Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab of the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen so they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
